# Bulk create

## Endpoint

`POST /api/v1/urls/bulk` with `{"urls": [{"url": "...", "customAlias": "...", "expiresAt": "..."}]}` creates 1 to 100 links.

## Response

Always `200` with `{"created": n, "rejected": m, "items": [...]}`. Each item has an `index`, a `status` (`CREATED` or
`REJECTED`) and either the `code` and `shortUrl`, or the `error`. Items are independent: a rejected item does not stop the others.

## Limits

- An empty list or more than 100 items returns `400`.
- A bulk request counts as one create against the per-client rate limit, like `POST /api/v1/urls`.

# Changelog

## Expiry enforced on every redirect; bulk create

- Fixed: a link that expired while it was cached kept redirecting. Expiry is now checked on every redirect.
- Added `POST /api/v1/urls/bulk` (up to 100 URLs, per-item results), covered by the create rate limit.
- Added a partial index on `urls.expires_at` (migration V3).
